findings.title: Slot duration check is too strict
findings.body: The check `minutes % SLOT_MINUTES !== 0` rejects any duration not a multiple of 15 minutes, but the `scheduleTurnover` function in `src/turnover.ts` uses a 10-minute slot. This breaks the 10-minute turnover scheduling and violates the principle of least surprise. Either relax the check to allow 10-minute slots or update `scheduleTurnover` to use 15-minute slots.

summary.problem: The slot duration check is too strict and breaks existing 10-minute turnover scheduling.
summary.done_well: The new validation ensures slot durations are aligned with the room's booking granularity.
